name: APTDC Amaravathi Haritha Hotel Restaurant
signature_dish: Andhra meals at the government hotel by the Amareswara Temple
why_it_matters: AP Tourism's Haritha Hotel in Amaravathi town serves the temple-town's pilgrims to the Amareswara (Lord Siva) Temple and visitors to the ancient Amaravati Stupa and Dhyana Buddha statue. In a place with barely any standalone restaurants, the Haritha restaurant is the most dependable proper meal at the heritage site itself.
insider_tip: Amaravati is a temple-and-archaeology town, not a food town — plan meals around this restaurant's service hours. It is the practical lunch stop after the stupa, the ASI museum and the Dhyana Buddha statue.
signature_address: APTDC Amaravathi Haritha Hotel, Amaravathi, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh 522020

name: Hamsa Restaurant
signature_dish: Budget Andhra and Indian-Chinese meals by the bus stand
why_it_matters: A budget restaurant opposite the APSRTC bus stand in Amaravathi town — one of only a handful of eateries listed for the heritage town, and the easy stop for an arriving or departing traveller. Plain Andhra meals and Indian-Chinese at low prices.
insider_tip: Right by the bus stand — convenient if you are doing Amaravati as a day trip. Keep expectations modest: this is functional roadside dining, not a destination meal.
signature_address: Hamsa Restaurant, opposite APSRTC Bus Stand, Amaravathi, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh 522020

name: Vijaya Lakshmi's Vantakam AC Family Restaurant
signature_dish: Family-style Andhra meals — veg and non-veg
why_it_matters: An air-conditioned family restaurant in Amaravathi town and the highest-rated of the few dining options on TripAdvisor for the heritage town — covering both veg and non-veg, with parking. A comfortable indoor alternative to the bus-stand eateries.
insider_tip: The AC and family-friendly setup make this the pick if you are travelling with elders or children in Amaravati's heat. Confirm it is open before you set out — the town's restaurants keep limited hours.
signature_address: Vijaya Lakshmi's Vantakam AC Family Restaurant, Amaravathi, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh 522020

name: Relax Garden & Restaurant
why_it_matters: A garden restaurant listed for Amaravathi town — one of the small set of TripAdvisor-documented eateries in a heritage town with very little dining. The open-garden setting makes it a pleasant lunch stop between the stupa and the Dhyana Buddha statue.
insider_tip: Amaravati's dining is genuinely sparse — this garden setting is a nicer option than the bus-stand eateries when the weather is kind. Phone ahead to confirm it is serving.
signature_address: Relax Garden & Restaurant, Amaravathi, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh 522020

name: Guntur-side Andhra Meals Houses (base for Amaravati)
signature_dish: Fiery Guntur-chilli Andhra meals — the hottest table in the state
why_it_matters: Amaravathi the heritage town has almost no proper restaurants, so most travellers base their meals in Guntur city, about 35km away — the chilli capital of India and home to the state's fieriest Andhra meals. This is honest base-labelling: a Guntur eating plan is the realistic answer for an Amaravati trip.
insider_tip: Guntur food is genuinely the spiciest in Andhra — ask for chilli to be toned down if you are not used to it. Eat a full Andhra meal in Guntur before or after the stupa rather than relying on Amaravathi's thin options.
signature_address: Guntur city Andhra meals houses, Guntur, Guntur District, Andhra Pradesh 522001
